(CONSULTING SERVICES - FIRMS SELECTION)

Project Name: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR)

Project ID: P176371

Assignment Title: Consultancy Services for Development of Animated Video Content with Infographics, Data Visualizations and Voice-over Narration for EAC Online Statistics Learning Materials

Reference No.: TZ-EAC-564358-CS-CQS

1. BACKGROUND

The East African Community (EAC) Secretariat is implementing the EAC component of the Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR), with financing from the World Bank. The Program seeks to strengthen the production, harmonization, dissemination, and use of quality economic and social statistics in Eastern Africa.

Under EARSPforR, the EAC Secretariat has developed online learning materials in fourteen priority statistical domains for use by Partner State institutions and other data users. Although technically sound, many of the materials are text-heavy an

. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juh

esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juhul, kui tegemist on rahvusvahelist piirmäära ületava hankega või hankija on selle hanke alusdokumentides ette näinud.</cbc:Description> <cac:Language> <cbc:LocaleCode listID="LanguageCodeEU" listAgencyName="EU-COM-GROW" listVersionID="2.0.2">ET</cbc:LocaleCode> </cac:Language> </cac:Legislation> <cac:TenderingCriterionPropertyGroup> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">7c637c0c-7703-4389-ba52-02997a055bd7</cbc:ID> <cbc:PropertyGroupTypeCode listID="PropertyGroupType" listAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" listVersionID="2.0.2">ON*</cbc:PropertyGroupTypeCode> <cac:TenderingCriterionProperty> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">8a42266c5fb24e32ff421942459d66ac-1.1</cbc:ID> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Mis on Teie vastus?</cbc:Description> <cbc:

Le contrat avec autorisations de tâches (AT) est une méthode d'approvisionnement de services selon laquelle l'ensemble ou une portion des travaux sont réalisés « selon la demande ». Dans le cadre de contrats avec AT, le travail à réaliser peut être défini, mais la nature et les échéances précises des services, des activités et des produits livrables requis ne sont connus qu'au moment où le service est demandé pendant la durée du contrat. L'AT est un outil administratif structuré grâce auquel la Couronne autorise un entrepreneur à effectuer les travaux « selon la demande », conformément aux modalités du contrat. Les AT ne sont pas des contrats individuels. PROGRAMME DES MARCHANDISES CONTRÔLÉES La présente demande d’offres est assujettie au Programme des marchandises contrôlées (PMC). The Scope of Work covers the following points: · Task 1 – Create digital models · Task 2 – Validate and verify digital models or software components · Task 3 - Analysis, modification or creation of software components · Task 4 – Support execution of the software components in a series of simulations · Task 5 – Analyze simulations or software components · Task 6 – Collect data from real systems · Task 7 – Maintain software capability and support to partners for the knowledge transfer PERIODE OF THE CONTRACT The Period of the Contract is from date of Contract to March 31 ,2032, inclusive.
